headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Katz warned Hamas that if an Israeli soldier or civilian is abducted, the entire city of Gaza would be evacuated. He also stated that Israel would not retreat from its red line in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the Strip is demilitarized. Katz also addressed the campaign against Iran, claiming they eliminated Khamenei and removed the threat of nuclear annihilation, emphasizing that the mission is not over and they will strike again if necessary.
